7685095.baseName: Habitat 7ft Pre Lit Pencil Christmas Tree
7685095.variantName: Habitat 7ft Pre Lit Pencil Christmas Tree
7685095.sourceDescription: Transform your space with a Christmas tree that brings festive magic without taking over the room. This 7ft pre-lit tree has a slim pencil shape that fits into narrow corners and hallways with ease, making it a brilliant choice when floor space is tight. It's already threaded with 180 warm white lights that glow softly throughout the realistic branches, so there's no wrestling with tangled fairy lights or hunting for plug sockets. The tree comes with its own metal stand and needs minimal assembly to get it looking perfect. You're getting fixed branches with a mix of 3D and flat needles across 530 tips for that full, lifelike look. Just pop it up, plug it in and let the warm glow set the festive mood from the moment you switch it on. . vs90vmxp.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Matterhorn Pine - Warm White LED Lights
vs90vmxp.sourceDescription: A new addition to our range, introducing the stunning Pre-lit Matterhorn Pine, a brand-new and unique style featuring short-cut, 100% realistic pine needle branches and warm white led lights for an incredibly lifelike appearance. We love the authenticity of this realistic 7ft pre-lit Christmas tree, and it is one of the easiest trees to assemble due to its pre-upswept, hinged branches. However, due to the prickly nature of its realistic pine needle branch tips, we recommend wearing long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing out the branches for that perfect, full look. Picture shows 7ft version from our range. (Available 5ft - 8ft) Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

gps13c79.variantName: Pelle & Sol 4ft Snow-Tipped Flocked Christmas Tree with Metal Stand
gps13c79.sourceDescription: Create a snowy festive centrepiece with the Pelle & Sol 4ft Flocked Christmas Tree. Measuring 68 cm (D) × 68 cm (W) × 122 cm (H), this artificial tree features 320 snow-tipped branch tips for a full frosted appearance inspired by a winter woodland. Made from durable PVC and supported by a sturdy metal stand, it is designed for easy seasonal setup and reliable display throughout Christmas. The branches provide plenty of space for adding your favourite lights, baubles and ornaments, while the compact 4ft height makes it suitable for living rooms, bedrooms, hallways and other smaller festive spaces. 4FT FLOCKED CHRISTMAS TREE: Measures 68 cm (D) × 68 cm (W) × 122 cm (H), making it suitable for smaller rooms, hallways and festive display areas. 320 SNOWY TIPS: Features 320 flocked branch tips designed to create a fuller, snow-covered appearance for a traditional winter look. DURABLE PVC CONSTRUCTION: Made from polyvinyl chloride for a reusable artificial Christmas tree designed for seasonal decorating. STURDY METAL STAND: Includes a metal base to help keep the tree stable and securely positioned during the festive season. EASY TO ASSEMBLE: Designed for straightforward seasonal setup with branches that can be expanded and shaped to create a fuller display. READY TO DECORATE: Provides ample branches for adding lights, baubles, ribbons and other Christmas ornaments to suit your preferred style. Read the instructions before use Dreibach LTD, Unit 2 Capital Business Park, Manaor Way, WD6 1GW, United Kingdom.

7rp7qb3y.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Hinged Christmas Tree Sturdy Stand - White - 150 cm
7rp7qb3y.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lights Hinged Christmas Tree Sturdy Stand - White - 150 cm
7rp7qb3y.sourceDescription: This Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree redefines seasonal décor with its realistic appearance and innovative design, transforming any living space into a festive haven. Its modern style and lifelike leaf arrangement make it a captivating centerpiece for homes during the holiday season while maintaining a sleek, minimal aesthetic. Crafted with simplicity and functionality in mind, this tree is easily assembled, blending seamlessly into various décor styles and imbuing environments with the warmth and joy synonymous with Christmas. Materials: Crafted from high-grade PVC and steel, offering durability and a realistic look. The materials ensure the tree withstands multiple seasons while retaining its visual appeal. This blend not only adds to the longevity but also enhances the visual aesthetics of the tree, making it look lush and full. Included Components: Equipped with decorative string lights that seamlessly adorn the tree, providing a warm white glow that enhances its natural look. Coupled with a reliable metal stand that ensures the tree stays upright and stable throughout the festive season. Features /Function /Design: The hinged construction allows for quick setup and disassembly, saving both time and effort. The lifelike tips give it a fresh, full appearance, while the foldable stand provides convenience for storage and stability in use. Recommended Uses: Perfect for living rooms, this tree can complement a variety of home decors, enhancing the holiday spirit. It transforms spaces with its decorative lights and creates a warm, inviting atmosphere. Care &Maintenance: Assemble according to the manufacturer's instructions for optimal stability. Ensure the LED lights are handled with care to maintain their function and longevity. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 104 cm Stand size: 35 cm Hinged construction for set up, Lifelike Tips, Foldable Stand Number of PVC tips: 519 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 150 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Cable length: 200 cm Indoor use only Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmastree 1 x Stand 1 x LED stringlight 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
